lines.text: Morning, Gilbert. Any water yet?
The shell? What shell?
But the crystals in your pipes are just like the ones at the bottom of the well.
Baldino! Vesk took the beam up to his ship. He's flying to Zeelich. His drill is pressing on the shell!
People like them. Zoé is already planning a hot bath.

There you are! You climbed into the well and vanished. What did you find?
The lighthouse. Baldino said three dials, then the microphone. What was the order again?
Dry again. But listen. Something is still knocking in there.
Vesk! "Ship capacity: 30%"? What about everyone else?
Sit. Eat. Then tell us everything. Slowly.
